provider.tool: REA MCP upstream REA with Ghidra provider
provider.basis: Evidence IDs are from the active analysis snapshot for this exact executable digest; the calls did not re-run the provider.

observed_behavior: Reads the attachment count from the model reachable through object+0x6C.
For each attachment, reads the 0x44-byte record through Model_GetAttachment and transforms translation and basis using the parent transform.
Looks up the attachment type by name in the registry at 0x00B97E00 with 0x28-byte entries.
Resolves the registered mesh and calls the type-indexed callback at 0x00A96AE0 when the slot is non-null.
The callback address is indexed by (backend_id & 0xFF) * 0x180 + type_id * 4; the indirect call receives object and local callback-context pointers, then the caller removes eight stack bytes.
Uses both formal arguments: the lifecycle caller at 0x004DEEC0 supplies the same object pointer twice.
0x004DFA50.catalog_signature_conflict: Candidate declares one argument and int* return; Ghidra decompilation and Radare2 recover two stack arguments, with Ghidra decompiling a void return. The candidate signature is not accepted as the retail ABI.

assembly_observations: At 0x004DF4CD, pushes the object pointer twice and calls 0x004DFA50.
The call is part of the branch where object field +0x18C is zero; the field is set to one after initialization.
The epilogue restores ESP from EBP and returns with RET, supporting cdecl; Ghidra's separate low-confidence API projection had guessed stdcall.
observed_behavior: On first initialization, clears/recreates child state, invokes 0x004DFA50 and 0x004DF500, then sets the initialized flag.
On later calls, updates attached-object transforms and processes event callbacks.
0x004DEEC0.catalog_name_limit: The generated catalog name is not supported by the observed lifecycle behavior.

observed_behavior: Registers task type MagicObj with size 0x138.
Registers event handlers including 0x004D9970, 0x004D9B10, and 0x004D9C30, then maps TASKTYPE_MAGICOBJ to the registered ID.
Registers task type MagicObjContainer with size 0x24.
Registers 0x00488700 as event-1 callback and 0x004E0890 as a type event handler.
Calls the QTask event-close routine with the global MagicObjContainer task type ID.
Calls the retail task constructor with the MagicObjContainer task type ID and null parent, then stores its second argument at task+0x20.

unresolved: The 0x00A96AE0 callback call shape is cdecl with two pointer arguments, but callback-specific types, callback behaviors, and the complete object state layout are not established.
Binary Ninja MCP and IGI-Probe observations were not available.
No new host implementation is authorized by this evidence alone; exact callback/manager ABI must be resolved before wiring the native lifecycle into the scene.
